DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Hepatitis, likely toxic or viral in origin.

The lab results confirm significant liver injury with markedly elevated transaminases (AST 488, ALT 798) and conjugated hyperbilirubinemia, alongside a mild leukocytosis. Given your history of diabetes and exposure to various foods at the state fair, this clinical picture strongly suggests acute hepatitis.
